d: Batterjee Medical College is seeking a qualified and motivated Clinical Instructor in Medicine to support clinical training within the General Medicine Program. This role focuses on supervising students during clinical rotations, bridging theory with practice, and ensuring students develop strong clinical competencies and professional standards.
Supervise and guide students during clinical rotations and practical sessions
Deliver bedside teaching, case discussions, and clinical demonstrations
Support development of clinical reasoning, patient assessment, and decision-making skills
Ensure safe, ethical, and professional conduct in clinical settings
Evaluate students’ clinical performance using structured assessment tools
Provide timely, constructive feedback to support development
Mentor students and support them in overcoming academic and clinical challenges
Participate in student evaluations and clinical assessments (e.g., OSCEs)
Contribute to course and program reports as required
Use LMS and digital tools to support teaching and documentation
Adhere to institutional policies, clinical regulations, and ethical standards
Collaborate with faculty, clinical teams, and hospital partners
Participate in academic activities, meetings, and professional development
Minimum 1 year of clinical practice experience
Experience in clinical teaching or supervision is preferred
Strong clinical knowledge and patient care skills
